Screenshot gallery (weather × time of day × lap position)

63 frames: SwiftShader, TLX default, 1280×720 orbit camera, grid frozen, weather() set after race(). Fracs 0 / .17 / .33 / .5 / .67 / .83. Eye-level frames at .17 / .5 / .83.

day · dry

Reference. Saturated cobalt sky and bright green verge: not the hazy, dust-shifted look the brief asks for. Lamp posts (black, slab heads) dominate the foreground.

day · overcast

Sky is the same deep blue as dry; only ground lighting dims. Overcast has no sky response.

day · fog

Fog is a distance blend on the ground only; the sky stays saturated blue, so the horizon shows a hard seam.

day · wet

Dark navy grade over everything; reads as night. Lamp posts reflect in the road. (Daytime-wet lighting is what PR #1979 is said to fix; not merged here.)

day · rain

Same navy grade as wet with rain streaks; sky still saturated blue. Reads as night, not rain.

dusk · dry

Good: violet sky, lamps lit, warm pools on dirt verge. Pit slab wall at frac 0 gets a flat pale tint.

dusk · rain

Lamps lit with halos, wet reflections present; ground very dark.

night · dry

Works well: lamp pools on both verges, cars lit, black sky. Frac 0 shows a bright featureless pit rear wall.

night · rain

Strong wet response: lamp halos, road reflections. Sky pure black.

dawn · dry

Weak dawn: close to dusk grade; cool sky, low-contrast ground.

day · dry · eye level

Driver-height view; verge and lamp posts read at scale, kerbs and painted arrows visible.
